dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 21, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Sunday Slugfests: Guardians Edge Tigers, Braves Blast Marlins**

In a day filled with thrilling performances, the Cleveland Guardians edged the Detroit Tigers 3-1 behind a strong outing from Joey Cantillo, who tossed 5.2 innings of shutout ball with six strikeouts. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense, homering for the ninth time on the season. On the other side of the border, Brandon Lowe and Marcell Ozuna each homered as the Pittsburgh Pirates topped the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2, with Braxton Ashcraft dominating on the mound, striking out nine over seven innings.

Meanwhile, Michael Harris II continued to shine for the Atlanta Braves, connecting on two home runs and driving in three runs in a 9-3 rout of the Miami Marlins. In another contest, George Springer's fourth home run of the season helped the Toronto Blue Jays blank the New York Yankees 2-0.
